detail.longDescription:
Since yesterday a lot of users in Europe found their workflows failing due to
Github seemingly randomly throwing HTTP/401 [https://http.cat/401] on git
clone/git pull when interacting with public repos without authentication. It was
now confirmed by staff member that this indeed is intentional
[https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/206581#discussioncomment-18269083]
and no further steps are planned at this point.
